title: Rock you could name, in five countries
question: Which side is made of rock you could put a name to? Step the slider: both sides show the same five worlds at the same camera.
context_md:
The ground is **90% of every picture** and until now it was one material: `stone`, four greys, with a warm tint and a pale tint sprayed over it by a 2-D noise blob that cuts *across* the bedding.

One side keeps that. The other gives the world six real rocks -- mudstone, sandstone, stone, limestone, ironstone, basalt -- decided **per bed** rather than per cell, so a layer is one rock from its floor to its roof and you can follow it along a cliff. They differ in hardness, in how coarsely they break and in their joint fabric, not only in colour.

Frames, in order: arid, canyon, rolling, terraced, wetland. Same seed, same camera, same binary, noon pinned.
